+def _event_handlers_lifespan(router: "APIRouter") -> Lifespan[Any]:
+    @asynccontextmanager
+    async def event_handlers_lifespan(
+        app: AppType,
+    ) -> AsyncIterator[Optional[Mapping[str, Any]]]:
+        for startup_handler in router.on_startup:
+            result = startup_handler()
+            if inspect.isawaitable(result):

+        yield None
+        for shutdown_handler in router.on_shutdown:
+            result = shutdown_handler()
+            if inspect.isawaitable(result):
+                await result
+
+    return event_handlers_lifespan  # type: ignore[return-value]
